description: Use when you need currency exchange rates, fx rates or forex conversion of an amount between two currencies like EUR and GBP. Do not use for live trading quotes, intraday or crypto rates (ECB rates update once per business day). Returns JSON with currency exchange rates: official ECB euro reference FX rates (free at ecb.europa.eu) for about 30 currencies, rebased to any base as cross rates, with optional conversion for 0.005 USDC per call. Typical response time 1500 ms (p95). Category: Data. Price: US$0.005 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

amount.description: Amount in the base currency to convert, e.g. 100

base.description: Base currency, ISO 4217 (EUR when omitted), e.g. USD

symbols.description: Currencies to return, e.g. ["BRL", "JPY"] (all ECB currencies when omitted)

name: blackwood_fx_rates
title: Currency exchange rates
